purpose: Casos de prueba que el futuro generador debe superar sin fijar Pueblos concretos como canon.

cases.setup: same worldSeed, rulesVersion, generatorVersion and stable settlement graph
expected: same town populations
same model assignments
same optional services
same households
same layout references

cases.setup: add a new optional service key without changing existing service keys
expected: existing service rolls remain stable
household seed remains stable
layout seed remains stable unless layout inputs materially change

cases.setup: rename a generated town while preserving stableSettlementId
expected: services unchanged
households unchanged
buildings unchanged
layout unchanged

cases.setup: network roll leaves a populated rural cluster without reasonable milling access
expected: one coherent candidate gains milling capability
region is not rerolled
coverage correction reason is recorded

cases.setup: two nearby towns fail trained healer roll but a third accessible town has one with reasonable coverage
expected: no forced duplicate healer if coverage is sufficient

cases.setup: nearby settlement has superior blacksmith capability
expected: village still retains mandatory local basic blacksmith capability
town still retains mandatory level 2 reference capability

cases.setup: two nearby towns serve overlapping village populations
expected: market scheduling attempts to avoid systematic conflict
market existence remains mandatory in both towns

cases.setup: flood temporarily blocks primary route after generation
expected: permanent services do not reroll
travel cost or route availability changes
temporary practical reference town may change
large formal sawmill is absent unless separately authorized by higher-level canon
timber logistics can still be visible
fishing activity present
urban port or naval identity not implied
mill only possible when hydrology allows
dwelling count derives from resolved households
services sharing residences do not create unnecessary extra buildings

cases.setup: load older save after rulesVersion increases
expected: persisted town remains unchanged unless an explicit migration is applied
